function: Joint learned UAV trajectory, IoRT device and UAV transmit power control, partial task offloading ratio and CPU-frequency allocation to minimize total offloading delay (pp. 6-7).
system: 1 HAP at 20 km, 3 UAVs at 100 m, 15 IoRT devices; LoS device-UAV links, 2 MHz per device; antennas and carrier frequency not stated (pp. 4, 10).
method: Multi-agent reinforcement learning: MADDPG with improved prioritized replay (MADDPG-IPER) for trajectory and device power; noise-value IPPO (NV-IPPO) for offloading, UAV power and CPU allocation (pp. 8-10).
data_channel: Own simulator: LoS device-UAV gain from reference distance and squared distance, free-space loss for UAV-HAP; task parameters set in ranges; no dataset or measurements (pp. 4, 10).
test_conditions: Same simulated network for training and evaluation; sweeps over devices per UAV (4-8), task size, CPU frequency, bandwidth; no test of a trained model in unseen settings (pp. 10-12).
baselines: Learned: JFAM (federated RL + MADDPG [32]), JIAM (IPPO + MADDPG), JHAM (HATRPO + MADDPG [33]); ablations MADDPG-IPER-IPPO and MADDPG-NV-IPPO; no non-learned baseline (pp. 10-11).
metrics: Total task offloading delay in seconds and its percentage reduction against baselines; convergence reward over episodes; UAV trajectories (pp. 11-13).
complexity: Order O(sum a_l x a_(l+1) + sum c_l x c_(l+1)) over actor and critic layer widths; no numerical value, FLOPs or runtime (p. 10).
q1_support: p. 4: "the IoRT devices can be viewed as a line-of-sight link". Channel gain is beta0 over squared distance (Eq. 6) and UAV-HAP uses free-space loss (Eq. 10); own simulator, no 3GPP TR 38.811 or measured data.
q2_support: p. 11: "Total task offloading delay versus number of IoRT devices served". Only parameter sweeps are plotted (Figs. 5-9); no trained model is tested in a setting unseen in training and retraining per setting is not described.
q3_support: p. 11: "the following three algorithms are compared with it". JFAM, JIAM and JHAM are all DRL methods and the two variants are ablations; no non-learned baseline (random, greedy, fixed, optimization) is compared.
q4_support: p. 10: "the complexity of the proposed JPTORAUTD algorithm can be expressed as". Eq. (60) gives the order as sums of layer-width products for the actor and critic networks.
q5_support: p. 10: "we present simulations to demonstrate the effectiveness". Own simulation with parameters in Table II; no code or data link, no public channel dataset, no measured data.
notes: Borderline above_phy: the objective is task offloading delay and most learned actions are above PHY (trajectory, offloading ratio, CPU allocation). Included because the agents also learn IoRT device and UAV transmit power on air-ground links (pp. 6-7), counted as physical layer in aerial links; area 6 as power control for UAV and HAP links. Reviewer should confirm.
